scope: Proposition 2.5 (Projection measure) of the manuscript “Petty’s projection-volume conjecture in dimensions at least four” (preprints/Pettys-projection-volume-conjecture-in-dimensions-at-least-four-September-24-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 088 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 ce25657d3f42aebb), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 6. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Translate and dilate a convex body K so that 0 ∈ int K and |K| = κn. Define ηK by ∫︂ ψ(x) dηK(x) = Eσ [︁ gK(u)−n ψ (︁ ∇gK(u) )︁]︁ (8) for nonnegative Borel functions ψ; the choice of the gradient on its null exceptional set is immaterial. Then ηK is an admissible probability measure of bounded support. Equality in (7) for ηK and a symmetric body M holds if and only if K is a translate of a positive dilate of M. Moreover, hΠK(y) = nκn 2 ∫︂ |x · y| dηK(x) (y ∈ Rn ), (9) and ∫︂ hK(x) dηK(x) = 1. (10) For the unit ball, ηBn 2 = σ, and consequently nκnbn 2 = κn−1. (11)
